Name: Shallum, Son of Josiah
Summary: Shallum, son of Josiah, also called Jehoahaz, reigned three months in Jerusalem before Pharaoh-necho carried him to Egypt, where he died. Jeremiah told his people not to weep for dead Josiah but for Shallum, who would never return.
KeyStory: Shallum reigned in his father Josiah's place, was taken to Egypt, and never saw his native land again.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Pharaoh Necho
LifeLesson: A three-month reign can still end in a permanent exile — length of rule is no measure of its weight.
